conventions: byte strings are lowercase hex (vv-01 §3.4); integers are JSON numbers unless they may exceed 2^53 - 1; text is a JSON string

transcripts.description: full handshake: alice (initiator) to bob (responder), no pair PSK
transcripts.note: trace lists ck and h after each Noise token (initiator side for message 1 including the initial state, responder side for message 2); the switch path carries message1 and message2 unfragmented after type byte 10 or 11 (switch_datagram1, switch_datagram2; vv-02 §1, vv-04 §6)
psk2 is mixed only at the end of message 2, so a responder without the pair PSK still reads message 1; the initiator then fails to read message 2

cookie.description: cookie reply triggered by fragment 0 of message 1
cookie.note: the receiver of the reply tries the mac1 of fragment 0, then of fragment 1

cookie.description: cookie reply triggered by fragment 1 of message 1
cookie.note: the receiver of the reply tries the mac1 of fragment 0, then of fragment 1

cookie.description: retransmission after the cookie reply: a new message 1 whose fragments carry mac2
cookie.note: the sender index and ts are new values chosen for this attempt
